criteria.name: base_values
criteria.description: Reports duration_days = 36, peak_wind_kmh = 249.9984, and local_event_rainfall_mm = 393.6 over the locked event window with correct units or unit-implied field names.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1.3 points per correct base value; withhold credit for values outside the listed tolerances.

criteria.name: threshold_ledger
criteria.description: Applies the 30-day, 200-km/h, and 300-mm tests correctly and reports threshold_pass_count = 3.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1 point for each correct pass/fail test and 1 point for the correct pass count.

criteria.name: normalized_load_index
criteria.description: Uses duration_days/30 + peak_wind_kmh/200 + local_event_rainfall_mm/300 and reports 3.762.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct formula with arithmetic mistakes, 1 point for correct component ratios, and 1 point for acceptable rounding.

criteria.name: severity_label
criteria.description: Gives triple_threshold_high_cyclone_load or a strictly equivalent compact label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a high-load cyclone label that misses the three-threshold condition.

criteria.name: classification_reasoning
criteria.description: Shows that the final classification depends on persistence, wind intensity, and rainfall accumulation all clearing their tests.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points when the reasoning uses only two dimensions or does not connect the index to the threshold tests.

criteria.name: answer_format
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with exactly the requested fields and no unverified extra loss or impact numbers. Full credit also requires the `reasoning_depth` object to identify decisive evidence, reject the main tempting simplification, and state a bounded uncertainty or scale caveat.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for minor formatting problems that do not obscure the values.
